entities.name: St. Nicholas Cathedral, Harbin
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Saint Nicholas Cathedral was a wooden Orthodox church in Harbin, China. It was located in the center of Cathedral Square, in the upper part of the Nangan district. The cathedral was one of the main symbols of Harbin Russians.
